description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipe for Qwen's official Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8 (block-wise FP8, Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision 9d1823d2) served by vLLM on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD=1, FlashInfer attention, FP8 KV cache, fastsafetensors loading, prefix caching, qwen3_coder tool parsing (no reasoning parser), eugr's fix-qwen3-coder-next and fix-qwen3.5-chat-template mods (baked into the image at build time, in upstream's order; on this image the two vLLM source patches of the first mod report themselves as not applicable and are skipped, exactly as they would at upstream's container start, and its Triton allocator fix and the unsloth chat template, selected with --chat-template, are installed), 262,144-token context, 16,384 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults); scheduler sequence capacity is left to vLLM as upstream does not set it. This is upstream's recipe as written (tensor parallel 2); the Controller runs it as native multi-node vLLM (eugr's default no-Ray cluster mode, instead of --distributed-executor-backend ray). No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Qwen3.5 35B-A3B FP8 vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
